VPL_v5.rule: F8 (natural, continuous cost, fallbacks costed): routed total realised cost < best constituent total, routed malformed plans <= best constituent malformed plans, one-sided exact sign test over held-out items p < 0.05, routed median latency <= 60 s and <= 5x the best constituent's median. Best constituent chosen on held-out results (lowest total realised cost). Per-date sign test, per-stream results, abstention rates, practitioner, ablation and compiled-arm comparisons reported, not part of the rule. VPL = families meeting their rule.
